notes.title: The Bunker, The Complex and more in the Ultimate FMV Bundle
notes.content:
Today we have a lot of news to share including the release of our latest interactive movie, The Complex!

Firstly, you will notice a small update to The Bunker which addresses some minor stability issues. Plus, The Bunker is on sale with 50% off starting today at 6pm BST.

The Interactive Movie Bundle
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13435

The Ultimate FMV Bundle
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13434

The Complex 

From the publishing studio behind Late Shift, comes a new cinematic interactive sci-fi thriller movie for PC, Mac, PS4, Xbox One and Switch.

After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. With choose-your-own-path style gameplay, your actions and your relationship with other characters will lead you to one of eight suspenseful endings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36752512/503b73e604e8a4e37b36d1bb895242ca0dcb79bb.jpg

We want to thank everyone for their support in the build-up to the launch. With just hours of being released, we've had some incredible reviews which we'd like to share with you :)

9.5/10 – God is Geek
“Story is fantastically written, acting is brilliant and multiple endings massively help with replayability.”

9/10 – Digitally Downloaded
“Phenomenal cast, complicated characters, a deep and rather dark narrative.”
 
8/10 – Gamespew
“A sharp, smartly written interactive thriller, with not a single one-dimensional character in sight, The Complex is (despite its theme) a joy to experience.” 

9/10 – Hooked Gamers
“Wales Interactive has earned itself a reputation for being the bar to be measured by in the interactive movie genre, and I can’t wait to see where they go with it next.”

9/10 – Adventure Gamers
“Once The Complex enters full-on thriller mode, this compelling choice-driven tale of a trapped scientist facing terrorists and moral decisions doesn’t let up and even provides enough prompting and interesting options to weather multiple plays.” 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28053821/9f7f7819b1734c198ed7e9d262832467e8fb6215.jpg

That's it for now! Comment below or reach out to us with any of the links below. 

Wales Interactive

www.twitter.com/walesinter
www.facebook.com/walesinteractive
www.instagram.com/walesinteractive

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1107790/The_Complex

notes.title: The FMV Horror is On Sale!
notes.content:

The interactive horror movie, The Bunker, is now 40% in the Wales Interactive sale! 

The Bunker is a completely live-action experience, filmed on location in a decommissioned government nuclear bunker with a plot crafted by the writer and designers behind The Witcher, Broken Sword and SOMA. Starring an incredible cast including Adam Brown (The Hobbit), Sarah Greene (Penny Dreadful) and Grahame Fox (Game of Thrones). 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25721079/271fb7215af3d62392d95b32ea759cb3e5cfe268.png

GamesRadar “The other hero here is the sound design and music…Playing in the dark with my headphones in, this scene got under my skin in in a way few games have.” 
True Achievements "The Bunker is a special game in that it tries to be different from everything else and developers have done a great job in creating a tense adventure." 4/5 
God Is Geek "The Bunker is something genuinely new, compelling and wonderfully original." 7/10
Destructoid “The Bunker perfectly captures John’s sense of claustrophobia and paranoia with intense close-ups, security footage, and just a really good use of lighting.” 7/10 

Not only that, you can also save on our other award-winning FMV games, Late Shift, The Shapeshifting Detective and the FMV Bundle!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25721079/b7a128941eddb7354df8e69d4a4329e364494b62.png

FMV fans we have a treat for you! We have recently announced a new FMV murder mystery game from the creators of The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker. The Shapeshifting Detective stars Rupert Booth (Contradiction) and a guest performance by Jesse Cox (youtube.com/jessecox).

You may have noticed that we have now permanently reduced the base price of The Bunker to align with our full collection of current and future FMV games on Steam! You can now purchase The Bunker for almost half the price of a cinema ticket — in UK unofficial currency, that’s the equivalent of 39 milk chocolate Freddos.

notes.title: Another Award Nomination, and a Charity Stream with the developers!
notes.content:
Nominated for Game Design Award!

The Az Play awards have nominated The Bunker for the Game Design award! Once again, we're up against some stellar titles and we're very pleased to be nominated against some fabulous competition. The awards are held in late November, and we can't wait to see the outcome!


Charity Stream with Splendy

Splendy Interactive are taking party in a GamerGiving stream this Sunday! Playing their way through The Bunker, talking about the development and story of the game, and raising some money for charity! They'll be playing the game between 4pm-6pm EST on Sunday - Here's the full stream lineup!

http://i.imgur.com/r967pTo.jpg

notes.title: The Bunker has been nominated for three TIGA awards!
notes.content:
Each year, TIGA looks at some of the finest games to be released and recognises their achievements in a variety of different areas. The Bunker has been nominated for not just one, not two, but THREE awards in the TIGA Games Industry Awards 2016!

The Bunker is up for - 

Most Original Game
Audio Design
Game Of The Year


We're incredibly honoured to be nominated in these awards, and we're up against some fantastic titles. 

The Awards will be held on the 10th November, and you can read more about the 2016 TIGA Games Industry Awards right here.
